nodes.name: Simpro Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives every Simpro webhook event (created, updated, status ...). Only a TEST record that is NOT yet in HubSpot is acted on. ⚠ No auth (known open finding, left as is).

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: All settings in one place. Turns the event into a record type + the Simpro URL. Event types we do not handle end here.

nodes.name: Log Event
nodes.notes: Saves type, Simpro ID and action so runs are searchable in the Executions list.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Record
nodes.notes: The full Simpro record. The only Simpro call for most events (non-test records stop right after it).

nodes.name: Select Test Record
nodes.notes: Test-record rule. Not a test record = ends here, nothing else is called. Otherwise builds the HubSpot existence search.

nodes.name: Find in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Is this record already in HubSpot? Searches the unique Simpro ID property (a contact is also matched on email).

nodes.name: Check Is New
nodes.notes: Already in HubSpot = ends here (updates belong to the 30-minute sync). A new contact whose email belongs to another HubSpot contact fails loudly.

nodes.name: Load SPL Users
nodes.notes: Reads the SPL Users table once (Simpro_ID -> HubSpot_ID) for deal owners. Only used by quotes and jobs.

nodes.name: Build Create Request
nodes.notes: The ONE create call (field mapping per record type) plus the related records to link.

nodes.name: Create Record in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Creates the record. No automatic retry: a create must never run twice.

nodes.name: Build Related Lookups
nodes.notes: Which related records already exist in HubSpot? One batch read per related type. None = ends.

nodes.name: Look Up Related in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch read of the related records by their unique Simpro ID.

nodes.name: Build Associations
nodes.notes: Plain links = no label. Quote/Job primary contact = Decision Maker. Job -> quote = Job/Quote label. Missing related records are skipped and listed.

nodes.name: Create Associations in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch associate / batch create with labels. Idempotent, so it may retry.

nodes.name: Check Association Results
nodes.notes: Fails loudly if HubSpot rejected part of a batch (for example a label limit).

nodes.name: Build Section Request
nodes.notes: Quotes and jobs only: asks Simpro for the sections (cost centers hang off sections). Others end here.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Sections
nodes.notes: Simpro sections of the new quote/job.

nodes.name: Build Cost Center Requests
nodes.notes: One request per section.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Cost Centers
nodes.notes: Simpro cost centers, one call per section.

nodes.name: Build Line Items
nodes.notes: One line item per cost center, price = GST-exclusive total, batches of 100.

nodes.name: Create Line Items in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch create. No automatic retry: creates must never run twice.

nodes.name: Check Line Item Results
nodes.notes: Inspects the batch response and guards the created count.

parameters.content:
## [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot (Real Time): create and link only
Self-contained: no sub-workflows. The webhook is the only trigger.

1. Fetch the Simpro record. Not a test record = stop.
2. Already in HubSpot (by its unique Simpro ID) = stop. The 30-minute sync workflows own updates.
3. Create it, then link it to the related records that ALREADY exist in HubSpot (never created or updated here):
   - Quote/Job primary contact: label **Decision Maker**; additional contacts: no label
   - Job -> the quote it was converted from: Job/Quote label (quote is the FROM side)
4. Quote/Job: create the line items from the Simpro cost centers (GST-exclusive price).

**After import (manual steps)**
- Connect `SPL Simpro` and `SPL Account` on every credentialed node and confirm no 'not connected' warning remains.
- Open `Load SPL Users`: it must read the SPL Users data table.
- Set Settings > Error Workflow.
- Import into the EXISTING workflow (select all, delete, import) so the `hubsput-upsert` webhook URL stays valid.

⚠ The webhook has no authentication (known open finding).
**Quotes and jobs only:** the row below creates the line items. For other record types `Build Section Request` returns nothing and the branch ends.
